extracted.subtask_description: A publisher-maintained database to help literary agents identify the best Simon & Schuster editor (and imprint/category) to submit a client's manuscript to. Emphasizes that Simon & Schuster does not accept unsolicited or unagented submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended users / purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Simon & Schuster Submission Selector is a database intended for use by literary agents to find the best Simon & Schuster editor to submit their clients’ projects to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this tool if you are a literary agent seeking which Simon & Schuster editor and imprint are the best match for a client's manuscript. The selector is targeted at agents rather than direct authors; it is a matchmaking/resource tool rather than a submission portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission policy — no unsolicited or unagented submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Simon & Schuster does not accept unsolicited or unagented submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should be submitted via a literary agent. For full details and any exceptions, consult Simon & Schuster's full manuscript submissions policies (the page references a link to 'Full information about our manuscript submissions policies can be found here').

rubrics_metrics.name: Category selection / genre classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should be categorized into one of the listed categories so agents can identify the appropriate editor/department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page enumerates a wide range of categories to match projects to the right editorial home. Categories listed include: Audio; Beginning Readers; Behavioral Psychology; Biography; Board Books/Novelty Formats; Book Club Books; Business; Chapter Books; Commercial Fiction; Commercial Women’s Fiction; Cooking; Decorating and Design; Diet; General fiction; General non-fiction; Gift; Gift/Illustrated; Graphic Novels; Health; History; Horror; Humor; Interior Design; Lexicon; Licensed/Media Tie-In; Lifestyle; Literary fiction; Memoir; Middle Grade Adventure Stories; Middle Grade Animal Stories; Middle Grade Fantasy/SF; Middle Grade Fiction; Middle Grade Historical Fiction; Middle Grade Humorous Stories; Middle Grade Marginalized Voices; Middle Grade Mystery & Suspense; Middle Grade Non-Fiction; Middle Grade School Stories; Middle Grade Sports Stories; Mind, Body, Spirit; Music; Mystery/Crime; Narrative Non-Fiction; New Adult; Non-Fiction Picture Books; Parenting; Picture Books; Politics/Current Affairs; Pop Culture; Reference; Relationships; Religion; Romance; Romantasy; Sci-Fi/Fantasy; Science; Self Help; Spirituality; Sports; Thriller; True Crime; Young Adult Commercial Fiction; Young Adult Contemporary Fiction; Young Adult Fantasy/SF; Young Adult Fiction; Young Adult Historical Fiction; Young Adult Horror; Young Adult LGBTQ Fiction; Young Adult Marginalized Voices; Young Adult Mystery & Suspense; Young Adult Non-Fiction; Young Adult Romance. Select the category that most closely matches your client's manuscript to locate the appropriate editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imprint selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects/imprints are grouped under specific Simon & Schuster imprints; agents should identify which imprint fits the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists imprints to help match a manuscript to the correct publishing imprint/editorial team. Imprints listed include: 37 Ink; Adams Media; Aladdin; Alfabet (Veen Bosch & Keuning); Ambo Anthos (VBK); AnkhHermes (VBK); Atheneum; Atlas Contact (VBK); Atria; Avid Reader Press; Beach Lane Books; Caitlyn Dlouhy Books; De Fontein (VBK); Denene Millner Books; Emily Bestler Books; Gallery; Gallery 13; Gallery 13A; KokBoekencentrum (VBK); Kosmos (VBK); LAB Uitgevers; Little Simon; Luitingh Sijthoff (VBK); Margaret K. McElderry; Marysue Rucci Books; Mozaïek (VBK); Omniboek (VBK); One Signal; Primero Sueño Press; Saga Press; Salaam Reads; Scout Press; Scribner; Scribner Canada; Simon & Schuster; Simon & Schuster Audio; Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers; Simon & Schuster Canada; Simon & Schuster Canada Children; Simon 6; Simon Acumen; Simon and Schuster Australia; Simon Element; Simon Maverick; Simon Spotlight; Summit Books; TenHave (VBK); Van Dale (Veen Bosch & Keuning); VBK België (VBK); Washington Square Press; Zomer & Keuning (VBK); Zwartjes en Labovic (VBK). Choose the imprint that best matches the manuscript's audience, format, and market positioning.
